reponse: The old method (FEATURE_FLAGS=new_dash in .env.local) no longer works: since PR #447, flags are served by the API via GET /api/flags, and the flag was renamed dashboards_v2 [2]. To enable it locally, run `make dev-flags FLAGS=dashboards_v2` with the API running, then hard-reload the page; you can verify with `curl localhost:8000/api/flags` [3]. Note that new workspaces with no events show a blank grid [5].
